commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 3 - 0 Savio (Girona) dribbles into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. Sensational solo goal.

90+4' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Stole Dimitrievski shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+3' One of the Rayo Vallecano players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. That's a free kick to Girona.
90+1' Savio (Girona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' 2 - 0 Savio (Girona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Stole Dimitrievski with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The substitution has been made. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) has replaced Yangel Herrera.
89' Michel decides to make a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov will be replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
87' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
85' Yan Couto (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had an easy-decision to make.
85' Aleix Garcia (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
82' A decent effort by Aleix Garcia (Girona) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
82' Girona are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
81' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Miguel Crespo.

79' What a save from Stole Dimitrievski! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
78' Yan Couto (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
76' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
75' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
73' Michel has decided to make a change. Ivan Martin (Girona) replaces Portu.
73' It is time for a substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is on for Artem Dovbyk.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

72' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save.
72' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to find Savio, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Juanpe (Girona) for David Lopez.
69' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

69' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
67' Rayo Vallecano couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' Rayo Vallecano have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
65' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Jorge de Frutos is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
64' A substitution has been made. Unai Lopez goes off and Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
63' Offside again. Savio (Girona) couldn't find the way to beat the offside trap and has been caught a few times today.
62' There's an opportunity for Aleix Garcia (Girona) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
61' Portu (Girona) thought he had scored but it was disallowed as the ball ran out of play in the build up.
60' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
59' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Oscar Valentin and he is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Raul de Tomas.
58' Dangerous play by Yan Couto (Girona). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a free kick.
58' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
57' Viktor Tsygankov plays a lovely pass into Artem Dovbyk (Girona), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
55' The linesman signals that Yan Couto (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
54' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had an easy-decision to make.
52' 1 - 0 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez provides Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
51' A pass into the box finds Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Stole Dimitrievski denies him.
49' Handball by Portu (Girona). Rayo Vallecano are awarded the free kick.
48' The attendance is 8923.
48' Chance! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
47' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.
43' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
42' Yan Couto (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
40' Yan Couto (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Artem Dovbyk, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
39' Yangel Herrera (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

37' Yangel Herrera (Girona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
37' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Yan Couto (Girona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
36' A pass from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski and the move breaks down.
35' Yan Couto (Girona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

34' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle. Girona are awarded a free kick.
33' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle after Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.

32' Good touch by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
30' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Portu (Girona) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
28' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) jumps into a tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul. Girona have a free kick.
27' That looked a certain handball by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
26' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
22' Yangel Herrera (Girona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Aleix Garcia (Girona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
22' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to Girona.
21' Savio (Girona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick.
19' Savio (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

15' Yangel Herrera (Girona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.

11' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Paulo Gazzaniga!
10' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a long through ball, but Paulo Gazzaniga deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

8' That's unlucky! Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
8' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short corner kick.

7' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
6' Savio (Girona) is flagged for offside.
5' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. It's a free kick to Girona in a dangerous position.
4' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Yan Couto (Girona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
2' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Girona get a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
